en: Black-and-white panoramic view over a European town from an elevated vantage point. In the foreground is a landscaped park or garden with winding paths, trees, and terraced slopes. Industrial chimneys rise among dense trees and rooftops. Beyond, a compact townscape of gabled houses and low buildings spreads out, dominated near the center by a large historic church or town-hall–like tower with a baroque or late‑Gothic spire. Low hills form the distant background. There is no visible printed text or caption on the image.
